The license plate begins with "6E5", and the "E" suggests the South Moravian region (code B for Brno). Plates starting with "E" were used in Pardubice region after 2001 format... Actually, in the new system, Pardubice region uses E, and South Moravia uses B. So the photo is likely in the Pardubice region.

The low houses and the flat terrain fit Pardubice. This looks like the Prostějov or Olomouc area, but the plate points to Pardubice.
